system_appearance_font_noto_sans_sc: Source Han Sans / Noto Sans SC (must be installed)
system_appearance_save_error: Couldn't save appearance settings (they apply for now but reset to default after a restart): {error}
system_appearance_mode_description: “Match system” follows Windows' light or dark mode.
system_appearance_palette_description: The default is Kotone dark (blue-black with cyan / pink).
system_appearance_font_description: Fonts that aren't installed fall back to the default font.
system_appearance_custom_font_placeholde: An installed font, e.g. Microsoft YaHei
system_appearance_custom_font_hint: Use a font installed on this PC; if it's misspelled or not installed, the default font is used.
system_auto_admin_enabled_toast: On: Windows will show a UAC prompt every time Kotone starts
system_auto_admin_never_ask_toast: OK. You can turn this on or off anytime in “Settings → System”
system_auto_admin_body: Kotone is running as administrator. Should it request administrator rights through Windows UAC every time it starts? Then you won't have to restart it manually each time.
system_auto_admin_hint: Either way, you can change this anytime in “Settings → System”.
system_elevation_never_ask_toast: OK. You can restart as administrator anytime in “Settings → System”
system_elevation_blocked_body: Windows just blocked typing or key presses into the game: the game is running as administrator and Kotone isn't. Restart Kotone as administrator and they'll go through. Restart now?
system_elevation_body: Kotone is running with standard rights. When the target program (such as League of Legends) runs as administrator, Windows blocks text sent by standard-rights processes, so sending from Kotone fails. Restart as administrator now?
system_exit_body: Quitting completely stops voice input and global hotkeys. You can also minimize to the system tray and stay on standby in the background.
system_manual_download_body: “{name}” couldn't finish downloading from the mirror or the official source. Download it in your browser, then put it in the folder below.
system_manual_download_step_open_page: Click “Open download page” and download the files below from Hugging Face / GitHub (if the page won't load, try another network or a proxy).
system_manual_download_step_keep_names_b: Don't rename files or subfolders. For example,
system_manual_download_step_open_folder: Click “Open target folder” and put the files in it.
system_manual_download_step_recheck: Come back here and click “Files are in place”; Kotone will check again.
system_update_title_available: A new version of Kotone is available
system_update_description_available: The new version is ready. You can update straight from this version to the latest.
system_update_description_downloading: Downloading and installing the full update package. Keep Kotone running.
system_update_description_ready: Installation complete. Restart Kotone to use the new version.
system_update_notes_empty: No release notes for this release yet.
system_update_dialog_busy_error: An update prompt is already waiting for a response
system_update_never_saved: You won't be reminded about new versions anymore. Turn it back on in “About”
system_update_ready_later_toast: Update ready. It takes effect the next time Kotone starts
system_about_description: Version, updates, and Kotone's character file.
system_about_tagline: Local first · Private and secure · Feedback QQ group: 1092354484
system_about_update_available: New version v{version} available, not installed yet
system_about_update_downloaded: v{version} downloaded; takes effect after a restart
system_about_update_idle: Can check automatically at startup, or manually anytime
system_about_update_prompt_label: Notify me of new versions at startup
system_about_update_prompt_description: Shows the update window after startup when a new version is out.
system_about_update_prompt_on: You'll be notified of new versions at startup
system_about_update_prompt_off: You won't be notified of new versions at startup
system_about_footer: © 2026 The Kotone Project · Third-party notices: see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES
system_advanced_description_legacy: Models, API connections, sound, appearance, and system.
system_advanced_description: Models, API connections, sound, tuning, appearance, system, and browser. You can also just tell {name} and she'll set these up for you.
system_advanced_companion_moved: Wake-up, interaction, permissions and usage are on {name}'s own page.
system_advanced_call_button_title: Call button on the chat page
system_advanced_call_button_description: Click “Call {name}” on the chat page and she listens to you in her bubble. No setup needed. With local speech recognition, it starts first if it isn't running, then she listens.
system_advanced_call_button_hint: Typed chat, automations, and scheduled reminders don't need speech recognition.
system_advanced_appearance_description: Only affects the Settings window; the overlay and floating text in the game stay as they are.
system_tuning_warning: Don't change these unless you know what you're doing. The defaults keep the original behavior.
system_tuning_vad_description: Controls how readily silero mistakes background noise for speech. Only applies to one-shot / continuous (not the same as the silence timeout in voice input). Takes effect from the next utterance.
system_tuning_vad_hint: A higher threshold and a longer minimum speech make background noise less likely to be mistaken for speech.
system_tuning_hotwords_description: Bonus score for hotword matches: the higher it is, the easier hotwords match, but the more likely background noise is recognized as a hotword (e.g. “DPS” at the start of a sentence).
system_tuning_hotwords_hint: 0 = no bias (hotwords get no boost). Changes take effect after “Stop → Start”.
system_sound_record_hint: Plays when you press the hotkey and recording starts
system_sound_send_hint: Plays when a message is sent into the game
system_sound_microphone_section_descript: Shared by voice input and calls.
system_sound_microphone_row_description: The input device you speak into.
system_sound_duck_description: Temporarily lowers speaker volume while voice input is recording or she's listening, then restores it.
system_sound_intro: Sound cues: even without the overlay, or in a fullscreen game, you can hear whether recording and sending worked. The recording and send sounds each have their own switch, volume, and effect.
system_sound_effect_description: Press play to preview the current effect.
system_sound_trigger_record: · Hotkey pressed and recording started → recording sound
system_sound_trigger_send: · Message sent into the game (on release / second press / automatically when you finish a sentence) → send sound
system_sound_trigger_solo: · Continuous sending sentence by sentence: every send plays the send sound; recording that continues automatically doesn't replay the recording sound
system_sound_trigger_failure: · A failed recording or send makes no sound (the on-screen error still shows), so it's never mistaken for success
system_sound_custom_coming: Custom sound cues (upload your own audio, set separately for recording and sending) are coming in a later version.
system_general_language_description: Interface language. More languages coming soon.
system_general_start_page_description: Which page you see first when you open Kotone.
system_general_onboarding_description: Go through the setup guide again: add a DeepSeek API key and set the call key.
system_general_autostart_description: Opens Kotone after you sign in to Windows (current user only) · Synced live with Windows startup apps
system_stop_description: Stops what {name} is doing and all automations. Four ways: press Esc while she's controlling the game, the stop hotkey, say “停下” (stop), or Stop in the tray menu.
system_stop_hotkey_description: Works even when Kotone isn't listening; keys held down by automations are released too.
system_compat_hotkey_backend_description: Keep this on “Auto” unless a specific game doesn't receive hotkeys. Current: {current}
system_compat_auto_admin_description: When on, Windows shows a UAC prompt every time Kotone starts; regular desktop apps can't get administrator rights silently
system_diagnostics_description: Contains no recordings, recognized text, or hotwords, so it's safe to share with the test group admins. Flow events are recorded by default to help track down hotkey/fullscreen issues that are hard to reproduce.
system_diagnostics_recording_description: Writes flow events (hotkeys, overlay show/hide, send results). When off, nothing more is written to disk; existing files must be cleared manually
system_diagnostics_clear_dialog_descript: Deletes flow events and kotone.log. Recognition history, settings, and recordings aren't affected. This can't be undone.
system_diagnostics_clear_stop_recording: Stop recording diagnostics from now on
system_connections_group_recommended_hin: Reliable tool calling, reachable directly from China
system_connections_group_aggregator_hint: One API key for many models
system_connections_saved: Connection saved. The API key isn't written to the config file
system_connections_open_key_page_failed: Couldn't open the API key page: {error}
system_connections_intro_before: Pick a provider, enter the API key, and set it as {name}'s connection to start. To check that it connects, click
system_connections_intro_after: (reads the model list once, uses no tokens). Text processing (polishing, translation) can use these connections too. API keys are kept by Windows and never written to config.json.
system_connections_empty_description: Pick a provider below and enter an API key to start. Try DeepSeek or Qwen first.
system_connections_checking: Testing: reading the provider's model list…
system_connections_add_description: {count} providers, all through OpenAI-compatible APIs. Pick one and enter an API key.
system_connections_search_empty: Nothing found for “{query}”. Use “Custom” to connect any OpenAI-compatible API.
system_connections_model_placeholder: Model name, or type your own
system_connections_model_hint: Pick a model that calls tools reliably; if unsure, keep the default.
system_connections_key_placeholder_saved: Saved. Leave blank to keep it
system_connections_key_placeholder_new: Not written to the config file
system_connections_key_hint: Write-only: after saving, Windows keeps it and it's never shown again.
system_connections_delete_description: “{name}” and its API key will be deleted from this PC.
system_connections_delete_in_use: {name} is using it; after deleting, you'll need to pick another.
system_catalog_download_cancelled: Download canceled. You can resume anytime
system_catalog_download_failed_toast: Download failed. Change the download source and retry, or download manually and import
system_catalog_import_dialog_title: Choose the folder that contains the {name} files
system_catalog_ocr_upload_warning: Online text recognition uploads a screenshot every time
system_catalog_state_invalid: File check failed. Please download again
system_catalog_ocr_intro_before: Every call captures the game window and reads its text with the model selected here. With an online model,
system_catalog_ocr_intro_strong: every recognition uploads the screenshot to the provider
system_catalog_search_intro_before: Games patch every week or two, so what a model remembers about builds, augments, and strategies is often out of date. With web search, she searches before answering and lists her sources in the chat.
system_catalog_search_intro_strong: Search terms and the pages she reads are sent to the provider
system_catalog_tts_intro: The voice she uses for replies and reminders. Chat in other languages is translated into Chinese before she speaks it.
system_catalog_import_tooltip: If you downloaded the model files manually, import them from a folder (each file is verified)
system_catalog_connection_hint: The address and API key are saved in “Settings → API connections”; the API key is kept only by Windows.
system_catalog_guide_body: Download these files from the URLs below into one folder, then click “Import” on the model and choose that folder. Import checks each file's size and SHA-256.
system_models_dir_migrate_partial: Switched, but {count} items failed to move (download them again): {items}
system_models_download_failed_toast: Download failed. Follow the guide to download manually, or change the download source and retry
system_models_guide_load_failed: Couldn't load the manual install guide: {error}
system_models_recheck_missing: The complete model isn't there yet. Check the file names and folder, then try again
system_models_deleted_was_active: Deleted: {name} (active model reverted to the default)
system_models_activated_restart: Model switched; takes effect after a restart
system_models_restart_needed: Recognition settings changed: local speech recognition uses the new settings after it restarts.
system_models_dir_edit_hint: The path must contain English characters only; downloaded models will be moved to the new folder (items that fail to move must be downloaded again).
system_models_dir_invalid: {error}. Click “Change” to choose a new folder.
system_models_dir_hint: The model path must use English characters only, e.g. D:\KotoneModels.
system_models_history_dir_hint: Where history and playback audio are saved. New records go to the new folder; old contents aren't moved automatically.
system_models_loading: Kotone is counting up the models…
system_models_connection_hint: The address and API key are saved in “Settings → API connections” and never written to the config file.
system_models_list_hint: Online recognition works as soon as Kotone opens; local models must be downloaded first, and start once right after you select them.
system_models_network_description: By default, the ModelScope mirror in China is tried first, falling back to the official source if it fails.
system_plugins_description: Each plugin is one of {companion}'s skills you can also open and use on your own. Turn one off and its page, the tools it gives {companion} and its game events go away with it; {companion}'s tool list follows from the next conversation.
system_plugins_enable_desc: When it's off {companion} stops using it, and its page and game events stop too.
system_mcp_section_hint: MCP servers written by others; each server is one plugin. Import them from Claude Desktop or VS Code, or paste their config. Their tools are only used inside Kotone, never passed on to external agents.
system_mcp_dialog_description: Paste a config or import one from another agent. Before adding, you'll see what it will run on your computer.
system_mcp_paste_hint: mcpServers from Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor, servers from VS Code, or a single server. Keys written in the config go into Windows secure storage, not into mcp.json.
system_mcp_none_found: No MCP config from {app} on this computer.
system_mcp_risk: A third-party plugin is someone else's program: it runs on your computer with your permissions, or talks to someone else's server, and Kotone can't control what it does. Only add ones you trust.
system_mcp_trust_keys: Keys it needs: {names} (fill them in the plugin's settings; stored in Windows secure storage)
system_mcp_trust_moved: Keys written in the config ({names}) move into Windows secure storage and stay out of mcp.json
system_mcp_trust_after: Once added: when {companion} uses its tools, the results are treated as data; tools it doesn't mark read-only ask you the first time; its tools stay inside Kotone.
system_mcp_tools_hint: {companion} uses these when needed; you can also ask her to.
system_mcp_no_tools: Its tools aren't known yet; they will be after it connects once.
system_mcp_off_note: This plugin is off: turn it on in Plugins.
system_mcp_trusted_yes: Trusted: tools it marks read-only run directly; other tools ask you the first time.
system_mcp_trusted_no: Not trusted yet (added by editing mcp.json, or its config changed): every tool asks you the first time.
system_mcp_remove_confirm: Remove “{name}”? Its keys in Windows secure storage go too.
system_mcp_ask_note: A tool of the third-party plugin “{id}”
